description: This source file defines a class 'GroupByApiRootConvention' which implements the 'IControllerModelConvention' interface. The class applies a convention to ASP.NET Core MVC controllers by setting the API explorer group name based on the controller's route attribute, effectively grouping controllers in API documentation based on the route's API version segment.

classes.name: GroupByApiRootConvention
classes.description: Implements IControllerModelConvention to set API explorer group name based on route attribute, for grouping controllers by API version.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies the convention to the given controller, extracting the route attribute to determine the API version and setting the GroupName accordingly.
